channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Asian stocks gain despite easing pressure on global bond yields
item.description: Asian share indices hold gains on Friday, though they remain on track for weekly losses as pressure on global bond yields eases. US Treasury yields resumed their upward trajectory following a brief reprieve triggered by Wednesday’s unexpected Treasury intervention.

item.title: Euro: Further upside toward 1.1725 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights EUR/USD at 1.1685 holding recent gains, with intraday trading likely between 1.1655 and 1.1715.

item.title: United Kingdom Retail Sales decline 0.5% MoM in July, as expected
item.description: Retail Sales, a key measure of consumer spending, in the United Kingdom (UK) declined 0.5% month-over-month (MoM) in July after rising by 0.7% in June (revised from 1.0%), the latest data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Friday.

item.title: Gold hits fresh high since June, above $4,550 as receding Fed hike bets undermine USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest gains near its highest level since early June, touched earlier this Friday, and trades just above $4,550 heading into the European session.

item.title: WTI steadies near $86.00 as Iran sanctions threat offsets US inventory build
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $86.00 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. WTI steadies near one-month highs as traders continue to digest the Middle East developments.

item.title: Indian Rupee ticks lower due to elevated oil prices, recovery in US bond yields
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) edges down against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Friday. The USD/INR ticks up to near 95.72 as elevated oil prices and a sharp recovery in United States (US) Treasury Yields have weighed on the Indian currency.

item.title: 52.9: India's HSBC Manufacturing PMI falls in August
item.description: The preliminary reading of India’s HSBC Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) declined to 52.9 in August versus 53.5 prior, the latest data published by S&P Global and HSBC Bank showed on Friday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah advances despite record Current Account Deficit
item.description: USD/IDR extends its losses for the third successive day, trading around 17,760 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair continues to depreciate as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) maintains its strength, defying a sharp widening of Indonesia’s current account deficit.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 113.50 as bullish momentum persists above 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory near 113.55 during the early European session on Friday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) despite the cooling labor market. The minutes of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meetings will be released next Tuesday.

item.title: Euro sits near multi-month top vs weak USD as bulls await move beyond 1.1700 ahead of PMIs
item.description: The EUR/USD pair attracts some dip-buyers during the Asian session on Friday and climbs back closer to its highest level since May 14, set the previous day, with bulls now awaiting a move beyond the 1.1700 mark before placing fresh bets.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises to near 186.00 as bullish bias prevails
item.description: EUR/JPY remains stronger for the second successive day, trading around 186.00 during the Asian hours on Friday. The technical analysis of a daily chart indicates that the spot is moving higher within the ascending channel pattern, signaling a persistent bullish bias.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: 20-day EMA remains key hurdle
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades in a limited range at around 159.00 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Friday. The pair consolidates, while both the JPY and the USD are underperforming against their other currency peers.

item.title: Swiss Franc edges up against US Dollar amid heightened US debt concerns
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) resumes its upside journey against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after a corrective move the previous day. The USD/CHF pair is down 0.17% to near 0.7990 in the Asian trading session.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains ground above 0.7100 as US debt concerns weigh on US Dollar
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gains traction to near 0.7135 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) and is set for a weekly loss as traders viewed the US Treasury's bond buyback gambit as merely a temporary fix.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD surges to near $69.00 amid heightened volatility
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $68.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday. Silver prices rise as investors turn to safe-haven metals amid heightened volatility across global currency and bond markets.

item.title: United States Dollar Index trades around 99.75-99.70, hangs near three-month low
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, attracts fresh sellers during the Asian session on Friday, stalling the previous day's modest bounce from the vicinity of mid-98.00s, or the lowest since May 14.

item.title: British Pound edges higher to near 1.3650, UK Retail Sales data looms
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength near 1.3645 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) amid fading Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike expectations.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains ground amid rising oil prices
item.description: USD/CAD extends its losses for the third successive day, trading around 1.3770 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair loses ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) receives support from rising crude oil prices.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar extends gains to fresh high since June, above mid-0.5900s vs softer USD
item.description: The NZD/USD pair attracts buyers for the third straight day and climbs to a fresh high since early June, around the 0.5965-0.5970 region during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices remain on track to register strong weekly gains amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

item.title: Euro gains on hawkish ECB outlook despite firm US Dollar
item.description: EUR/USD remains stronger for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.1680 during the Asian hours on Friday. The Euro (EUR) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD), bolstered by strong economic fundamentals across the region.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7817 vs. 6.7808 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7817 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7808 and 6.7262 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI consolidates around $86.00; bulls potential intact amid US-Iran impasse
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – oscillates in a range around the $86.00 mark during the Asian session on Friday and remains well within striking distance of a three-week high, touched the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen flatlines after CPI inflation report
item.description: The USD/JPY pair holds steady near 159.05 during the early Asian session on Friday. Growing speculation that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) could raise interest rates next month offsets the weaker Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data.

item.title: Bessent says US unlikely to resume large-scale Iran combat, steps up economic pressure
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that the US President Donald Trump administration’s plan to crush Iran’s economy will likely negate the need for major US military operations against the Islamic Republic, CNBC reported on Thursday.

item.title: Gold drifts higher above $4,500 on US Treasury buyback
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) edges higher to around $4,530 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal rebounds after earlier falling following the US President Donald Trump administration’s unexpected decision to boost repurchases of longer-dated bonds.

item.title: Japan’s National CPI climbs 2.0% YoY in July, Core CPI rises as expected
item.description: Japan’s National Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed by 2.0% YoY in July, compared to the previous reading of 1.6% (revised from 1.7%), according to the latest data released by the Japan Statistics Bureau on Friday.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Bulls eye 217.00 as rally extends
item.description: The GBP/JPY advanced over 0.72%, refreshing a 14-day high of 216.90, with buyers eyeing a breakout above 217.00, which could open the door to a retest of the yearly highs hit in mid-July. The pair trades at 216.73 after bouncing off the daily low of 215.04.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens as US yields rebound, PMIs fail to impress
item.description: The Australian Dollar retreated against the Greenback on Thursday as US bond yields resumed their advance, despite the US Treasury's efforts to cap elevated yields following its announcement of a long-end bond buyback program. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7114, down 0.14%.

item.title: Australia's S&P Global Manufacturing PMI steadies at 52.0 in August
item.description: The preliminary reading of Australia's S&P Global Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) came in at 52.0 in August versus 52.0 prior, the latest data published by S&P Global showed on Friday.
